CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_host_expiry (
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 host VARCHAR(253) NOT NULL,
 checked_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
 cert_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
 cert_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 cert_issuer VARCHAR(200),
 cert_error VARCHAR(200),
 domain_name VARCHAR(253),
 domain_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
 domain_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 domain_error VARCHAR(200),
 PRIMARY KEY (client_id, host),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_host_expiry_cert_status CHECK (cert_status IN ('ok','invalid','error','no_https')),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_host_expiry_domain_status CHECK (domain_status IN ('ok','no_date','unsupported','not_found','error'))
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_robots_state (
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 origin VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
 checked_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
 robots_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
 robots_error VARCHAR(120),
 robots_hash VARCHAR(64),
 robots_body TEXT,
 robots_blocks_all BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 robots_previous_body TEXT,
 robots_changed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 robots_reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 robots_reviewed_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 sitemap_url VARCHAR(500),
 sitemap_source VARCHAR(16),
 sitemap_status VARCHAR(16),
 sitemap_url_count INTEGER,
 sitemap_has_more BOOLEAN,
 sitemap_error VARCHAR(200),
 PRIMARY KEY (client_id, origin),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_robots_state_status CHECK (robots_status IN ('ok','missing','error')),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_robots_state_sitemap_status CHECK (sitemap_status IS NULL OR sitemap_status IN ('ok','empty','invalid','error')),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_robots_state_sitemap_source CHECK (sitemap_source IS NULL OR sitemap_source IN ('declared','default'))
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_publish_checks (
 task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 url TEXT NOT NULL,
 task_completed_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
 status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
 attempts SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 checked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 http_status INTEGER,
 final_url TEXT,
 error VARCHAR(32),
 results JSONB,
 CONSTRAINT ck_task_publish_checks_status CHECK (status IN ('pending','ok','problems','unreachable','skipped'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_task_publish_checks_pending ON task_publish_checks (next_attempt_at) WHERE status = 'pending'
